description:
KCS 0.3.0's re-validation — the cheapest item on the promotability ladder after KGP, and unowned.

WHY IT IS CHEAP. Per docs/reference/promotability.md: 'a re-validation, no fold... The 0.3.0 change was additive and backward-compatible against a scenario that exists and whose encoding runs. This is a read-and-confirm pass, and nobody owns it.'

THE SNAG THAT MAKES IT NOT TRIVIAL — DR-10. 'the downstream §5 vocabulary has no `structure_matches`, which is the predicate the 0.3.0 fold IS, so the re-validation cannot be discharged by a machine replay of that clause — a hand-walk still can, and the drift is downstream work either way.' So the fold's own predicate is missing from the downstream vocabulary: the one clause this version added is exactly the one a replay cannot check.

SCOPE. The re-validation and KCS's own status. The downstream vocabulary drift is named, not fixed here — it belongs to whoever owns that vocabulary, and this tasklist's job is to state it rather than absorb it.

userStories.title: The re-validation is walked, with the 0.3.0 clause hand-checked
userStories.notes: Walked by hand 2026-09-03 against KCS 0.3.0 as published; recorded in scenarios/kcs-format-stress.md ('Re-validation — KCS 0.3.0, walked 2026-09-03'). Replay vs hand-walk split stated in an explicit evidence table and per-delta: M/N/O + the assertion half of P lean on the 2026-08-24 run of kcs:format-stress; Q in full, the firing half of P, and the clause re-read behind every replayed delta are hand-walked, because DR-10 leaves the runner without structure_matches. Per-delta verdict: M/N/O flip (replay-corroborated), P flips in prose with one declared residual (green run never exceeded a timeout, so the exceeded->fails-liveness path is unexercised), Q HALF-FLIPS -> new blocking delta R. Also recorded a correction to Attempt 3's own sketch: source_world_is(<render>, world) contradicts KMI §2 delta H (generated => null); the format expresses the correct form, so no delta. GATES: node scripts/check-doc-integrity.mjs OK (56 files, 1370 links, 3 status tables match); .chief/verify.sh --run over the changed paths: all selected gates green, verify-selftest 30 passed 0 failed. Fixed 8 pre-existing dangling links to the retired tasks/chief/89-*.json that had left main red on doc-integrity.
acceptanceCriteria: The 0.3.0 determinism fold (delta Q: `structure_matches` and the stability rules it carries) is re-validated against the existing scenario, with the `structure_matches` clause HAND-walked because DR-10 makes a machine replay of it impossible.

The rest of the pass may lean on the running encoding, and the record says which parts were replayed and which were hand-walked. Mixing the two silently is how a green replay gets read as a full verdict — the same failure DR-7 and DR-8 record against KCB.

userStories.title: KCS's status moves only on a clean pass, and DR-10 is stated as downstream
userStories.notes: Not-clean branch taken: the US-1 walk found new blocking delta R, so specs/conformance-scenario.md STAYS 0.3.0 Candidate — no version and no clause moved (verified by section-slicing HEAD vs new: §1-§6 and §8 byte-identical; only the header date, the Pressure-test gate sentence, a §7.2 evidence note and a new Editorial changelog entry differ, and the only removed lines are those two). Blocker named in five places: the spec's Pressure test (new 'The re-validation, walked 2026-09-03' block + §7.2 note + Editorial changelog entry, which also states the standard a future promotion is under — the ordinary conformance-gated rule, since 0.2.0's grandfathering does not survive a demotion and its artefact debt was paid 2026-08-19), specs/README.md's grandfather paragraph, docs/reference/promotability.md (KCS row + ladder item 2), ROADMAP.md's 'two of the six have no row here' paragraph, and CLAUDE.md's Current state bullet. Count changed shape: 'fold R, then re-validate again', unowned. DR-10 recorded as DOWNSTREAM under ADR-0001 and explicitly UNOWNED in promotability.md (row + item 2) and in the scenario's DR-10 section, split into the qualification (discharged by the hand-walk) and the drift (untouched); nothing in the downstream vocabulary was edited from this repo. GATES: node scripts/check-doc-integrity.mjs OK (56 files, 1383 links, 3 status tables match headers); .chief/verify.sh --run over the 6 changed paths: all selected gates green (doc-links 0 dead vs 2 on main); .chief/verify-test.sh 30 passed, 0 failed.
acceptanceCriteria: IF the re-validation is clean: `specs/conformance-scenario.md` moves to **ratified**, with the walk named in a changelog entry. Note KCS was grandfathered under the previous rule at 0.2.0 — say what standard this promotion is under.

DR-10 is recorded in `docs/reference/promotability.md` as DOWNSTREAM work with an owner named or explicitly unowned. It must not be closed here by editing the downstream vocabulary from this repo — koine specifies, and the vocabulary lives with its implementation.
IF the pass is not clean, the status does not move and the blocker is named. A read-and-confirm that confirms nothing is a legitimate outcome.
